描述_EN: goat's horn cups were foreign objects brought to china along the silk route. their unusual shape prompted chinese craftsmen to make imitations in jade. this cup is tall but tapers towards the base. cups of this shape were probably inspired by cups made out of goat's horn.
描述_ZN: 山羊角杯是沿着丝绸之路带到中国的外国物品。 它们不寻常的形状促使中国的工匠们用玉石制作仿制品。 这个杯子很高，但在底部逐渐变细。 这种形状的杯子可能是受山羊角制成的杯子的启发。
